title: Voz pasiva: ampliación guiada
summary: Con modelos y ayuda, reconoce frases que destacan qué ocurre a un objeto.
keyIdeas: Ampliación guiada: «Martina paints the mural» → «The mural is painted by Martina».
Usamos to be y participio: «is painted» en presente, «was painted» en pasado. Consulta los modelos antes de responder.
En estos ejemplos, by introduce a quien hace la acción: «by Martina».

activities.prompt: Follow the model «Paper is collected». Complete: Plastic bottles ___ in our school packaging bins.
activities.explanation: Las botellas están en plural: «are collected». Se recogen en los cubos; el reciclaje del material ocurre después en una instalación.
activities.hint: Fíjate si el sujeto es singular o plural.

activities.prompt: Read the sentence: 'The museum was opened in 1995.' This sentence is written in the passive voice.
activities.explanation: Es verdadero porque combina el pasado del verbo to be ('was') con el participio ('opened'), poniendo el foco en el museo y no en quién lo abrió.

activities.prompt: Complete with the correct auxiliary verb in the past passive:
activities.explanation: Usamos 'was' porque el sujeto 'This science project' es singular de tercera persona (it) y la palabra 'yesterday' indica pasado.
activities.hint: 'Project' es singular y ocurrió en el pasado.
activities.sentence: This science project ___ finished yesterday by Aisha and Wei.

activities.prompt: Match each base verb with its past participle form used in passive voice:
activities.explanation: Para formar la voz pasiva necesitamos el participio: 'written', 'built' y 'made' son irregulares, mientras que 'painted' es regular.

activities.prompt: Classify these sentences into Active Voice or Passive Voice:
activities.explanation: En la voz activa el sujeto realiza la acción directamente, mientras que en la pasiva el sujeto recibe la acción a través del verbo 'to be' y un participio.

items.text: The mural is painted by Martina.
The bicycle was repaired by Omar.
The rubbish was collected by the students.

activities.prompt: Which preposition introduces the agent (the person who did the action)? 'Harry Potter was written ___ J.K. Rowling.'
activities.explanation: En inglés, el agente que realiza la acción en la voz pasiva se introduce siempre con la preposición 'by'.

activities.prompt: Put the words in order to form a correct sentence in the past passive voice:
activities.explanation: El orden en pasiva es: Sujeto ('The new computers') + verbo to be en pasado ('were') + participio ('installed') + complemento ('today.').

activities.prompt: Choose the correct past passive form for this environmental action:
activities.explanation: Como 'Hundreds of young trees' es plural y ocurrió en el pasado ('last spring'), debemos utilizar 'were'.
activities.sentence: Hundreds of young trees ___ planted in the municipal park last spring.

activities.prompt: Read the text carefully and answer the questions:
activities.explanation: El relato inventado contiene modelos de pasiva como «was designed» y «are harvested».
activities.title: The Eco-Garden Project
activities.text: Last term, an exciting project was started at Greenfield Primary School. A new community garden was designed by students and teachers in an empty area behind the school gym. First, the old rubbish was cleaned up by family volunteers on a sunny Saturday. Then, wooden plant beds were built by the 6th-grade pupils with adult help, using reused wood from old desks. Organic seeds of tomatoes, carrots, and strawberries were planted carefully in the rich soil. Every morning, the young plants are watered by the eco-team monitors before classes begin. Last week, small solar lights were also installed to keep the garden bright at night. Now, fresh vegetables and fruits are harvested every Friday, and they are prepared in delicious salads for the school canteen. The headteacher explained that when nature is protected, our whole community becomes happier and healthier.

questions.prompt: Who built the wooden plant beds for the garden?
questions.explanation: El texto menciona explícitamente: 'wooden plant beds were built by the 6th-grade pupils'.

questions.prompt: Why did the pupils reuse wood from old desks?
questions.explanation: Se infiere que al ser un proyecto ecológico, reutilizar materiales antiguos reduce los residuos y cuida el planeta.
options: To help the environment by giving old furniture a new life.
Because the school gym was completely destroyed.
Because new wood is illegal in primary schools.

questions.prompt: Which sentence from the text is an example of the PASSIVE voice?
questions.explanation: 'Are harvested' utiliza el verbo 'to be' más el participio pasado, describiendo lo que le ocurre a las verduras y frutas.
options: Fresh vegetables and fruits are harvested every Friday.
Family volunteers arrived on a sunny Saturday.
Classes begin early in the morning.

activities.prompt: Transform this active sentence into passive: 'Adrián cleans the classroom whiteboard every afternoon.'
activities.explanation: La frase original está en presente simple ('cleans') y el objeto 'the classroom whiteboard' es singular, por lo que usamos 'is cleaned'.
activities.hint: Comprueba el tiempo verbal de la frase original (presente) y el número del sujeto.
options: The classroom whiteboard was cleaned by Adrián every afternoon.
The classroom whiteboard are cleaned by Adrián every afternoon.
The classroom whiteboard cleans by Adrián every afternoon.
The classroom whiteboard is cleaned by Adrián every afternoon.
